notes: Synthetic: authored by hand from the official Anthropic docs (platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages, build-with-claude/streaming, build-with-claude/thinking, build-with-claude/extended-thinking, agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool, build-with-claude/handling-stop-reasons, build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback, build-with-claude/citations), read 2026-10-28. Field names, event types and stop reasons are the documented ones; ids, signatures, token counts and text are invented. Replace each case with a recorded capture (source: recorded) when the live recorder runs. Pins the 2026 shape: stop_details (null unless stop_reason is refusal), usage with output_tokens_details/inference_geo/speed, and display-omitted adaptive thinking (thinking blocks with an empty thinking string plus a signature, streamed as one empty thinking_delta and one signature_delta). container and diagnostics are omitted: the reference types them nullable and they are only populated by code execution and the cache-diagnosis beta.

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: known gap T1/T2: thinking-block signatures are dropped (anthropicContentBlock has no signature field), so thinking_blocks reach the inbound translator unsigned and a multi-turn tool-use conversation with thinking cannot be replayed to Anthropic. With display "omitted" the whole block is dropped because its thinking text is empty

known gap S2: the refusal category and explanation (stop_details) are dropped, and stop_reason "refusal" itself is unmapped (see allowed_unknown_shapes), so a caller cannot tell a refusal from a normal stop
no canonical field: OpenAI has no slot for which stop sequence matched; finish_reason "stop" carries the outcome
known gap U2: the per-TTL cache-write breakdown (5m / 1h), needed to price 1h cache writes, is dropped

known gap U1: prompt-cache write tokens are not added to prompt_tokens (Anthropic's input_tokens excludes them), so usage and cost under-count cached requests. Usually 0 on the canonical path today, which rebuilds content blocks without cache_control
known gap U1: prompt-cache read tokens are dropped instead of counted in prompt_tokens and prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, so usage and cost under-count cached requests
known gap U7: the region that served inference (inference_geo) is dropped
known gap U6: output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens is dropped instead of mapped to completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens
known gap U3: the tier that served the request (standard / priority / batch) is dropped; ChatCompletionResponse.service_tier exists but the adapter never sets it
known gap U7: usage.speed is dropped; a fast-mode response (speed "fast") is billed at a premium the gateway's cost accounting cannot see
